title: pastinaca pumila
intro: Pastinaca pumila, commonly known as Wild Parsnip or Small Parsley Fern, is a perennial plant species native to Europe and Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, fighting oxidative stress, and supporting digestive health due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include treating various conditions such as arthritis, gout, and skin issues, attributed to its bioactive constituents like sesquiterpenes and phenolic compounds. The bioactive constituents of Pastinaca pumila include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
